features.quote:
Hard stop conditions:
- Model produces no tool call for 2 consecutive turns
- Turn count exceeds MAX_TURNS
- Model explicitly states task is impossible AND does not retry
Token budget per turn: Cap at 1500 output tokens. Most failure-mode behavior is detectable in shorter outputs; verbose models won't blow the budget.
features.justification_quote: Most failure-mode behavior is detectable in shorter outputs; verbose models won't blow the budget.

features.quote: set up parallelized trial runner with cost tracking (abort if projected cost > 2× budget)
